Attack Vector: Encrypts files on the compromised machine and demands ransom for file decryption
Indicators of Compromise: Files will be encrypted and changed to have a “.darky” file extension

Attack Vector: Encrypts files on compromised machines and adds a file extension named after the target company to the affected files
Indicators of Compromise: Infection occurs through an MSI (Windows installer) file delivered to the target machine

Attack Vector: Encrypts files on a victim’s machine and demands a price of $980USD to have software provided to decrypt the affected files
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted by vvyu will have a “.vvyu” file extension appended to them

Attack Vector: Encrypts files of interest on a victim machine and demand a ransom of $300USD worth of Bitcoin to be sent to a wallet controlled by the malware authors
Indicators of Compromise: Files will be encrypted and appended with a “.Kriptor” file extension

Attack Vector: Threatening to release a victim’s data on the Internet if they do not pay the requested ransom
Indicators of Compromise: Files encrypted by Cuba will have a “.cuba” file extension appended
